posts.title: all vulnerabilities are now race conditions
posts.description: TLDR AI made finding bugs cheap. It did nothing to make getting paid for them any easier. The same bug now gets found by ten different people inside a fortnight. One of them collects the money. The other nine collect a polite duplicate notice and a dent in their platform reputation. The programmes are drowning too. posts.title: I Missed One TLB Shootdown and Somehow Ended Up Controlling a Page Table
posts.description: TLDR I used a public Linux kernel bug to make one CPU keep using a memory mapping after another CPU had removed it. I then persuaded Linux to recycle the physical page behind that stale mapping as a page table.
